positive_findings.result: reading_units derives its units from the actual original Chinese prose renderer, rather than treating raw Markdown blank lines as final paragraph boundaries. It preserves p/h2/blockquote classes and rejects unexpected top-level blocks, attributes and unsupported reading syntax. Essay05 remains one quoted unit with two internal line breaks. Source-only tests exercise all68 articles:1265 paragraphs,507 headings and129 quotations,1901 units total. This mechanical reading contract is not a substantive review of all68 essays.

The current adapter obtains real per-article source notes and citations from original.render_article in memory, keeping Chinese text and exact absolute URLs, rather than replacing every article with a common-paper reference. It preserves the existing175 note paragraphs and178 ordered references, including distinct commentary cautions and the four research DOIs. The currently present source apparatus is fully captured by the actual tests. The initially discovered unexpected-container weakness below has now been fixed by the lead editor and independently read and retested.

The opted-in digest includes raw current Chinese Markdown bytes, raw entire manifest bytes with explicit byte lengths and a stable serialization of the canonical article bundle. The canonical bundle includes actual selected note text and ordered source titles/URLs. Canonical English and traditional-Chinese Markdown are separately protected with all204 reading files and the unchanged three-mode article bodies. The manifest's historical source_sha256 is not misused as the current edited Markdown fingerprint.

The original builder adds marked language controls only when an actual publication.json exists and require_review_seal passes. It does not treat a partial first batch as complete. No Zhuangzi receipt exists during this audit. Source-only tests show all69 primary-control upgrades are idempotent, preserve complete main areas and all three bodies, and reverse to exact original bytes when only the known controls and alternates are handled.

The new helper reads the five real groups from the original GROUPS and manifest. It retains encounters01–10, inner11–29, discernment30–41 plus59–65, outer42–58 and closing66–67 rather than forcing a false numerical partition. It also preserves the original numerical sequence in a closed details element, a separate guide card, five route entries, group anchors and the real four-source research section. It validates all68 article slugs and required native metadata; partial manuscripts cannot pass that validator. Source-controlled slugs/IDs and escaped native text are used. The CSS provides a narrow-screen single-column route layout and visible keyboard focus. No unapproved foreign index was rendered to test appearance.
